title: Croatian Beef Skewers
description: A simple and flavorful recipe for beef skewers inspired by Croatian cuisine. The combination of marinated beef, crispy onions, and wild herbs creates a delicious and satisfying meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the beef cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Thread the marinated beef onto skewers.
Brush the grill with oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally.
Meanwhile, toss the crispy onions with a little olive oil and sprinkle with salt.
After 5 minutes of grilling, add the crispy onions to the skewers and continue cooking for another 3-5 minutes.
Remove the skewers from the grill and let rest for 2-3 minutes.
Serve immediately, garnished with chopped wild herbs.
